producer_report.summary: `JobRecords::title` in store.rs now takes a request's title from the first non-empty line that isn't a `Priority:` line, so `athena plan` and `athena status` show the real title. The Priority check is trimmed and case-insensitive. A request made only of Priority lines keeps its first line. The line selection is a new shared helper, `plan::title_line`. Titles that come from a reading are unchanged. The new tests pass, including the 'Priority: urgent' plus 'Fix the widget' case for both the plan entry and the status line. I ran only the targeted `cargo test -p athena-core title`, the policy test and the fmt check. I did not run clippy or the full `cargo test`; those are left to Athena's checks. CHANGELOG.md has a new Fixed entry under Unreleased.

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test, run with `cargo test -p athena-core`, builds a request whose text starts with 'Priority: urgent', then a blank line, then 'Fix the widget'. It asserts the title is 'Fix the widget' in both the plan entry (topics/plan path) and the status output (status.rs).
criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo test -p athena-core title`. reading::tests::the_plan_entry_title_skips_a_leading_priority_line asserts the plan_entry title, and status::planning_cost_tests::the_status_title_skips_a_leading_priority_line asserts the job_line title. Both use 'Priority: urgent\n\nFix the widget' and both pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Tests cover a lowercase/indented 'priority: high' line, a request with no Priority line (the title is still its first line), and a request made only of Priority lines (falls back to the first line). `cargo test` passes.
criteria_check.evidence: Those cases are in the plan.rs, reading.rs and status.rs tests, and the targeted run passed. I did not run the full `cargo test`; that is left to Athena's checks.
left to Athena's checks. I ran `cargo fmt --all --check` and it passed.

criteria_check.criterion: The diff to crates/athena-core/src/plan.rs adds the shared title helper, and the diff to crates/athena-core/src/status.rs adds or updates a status test; the title logic in store.rs uses the helper instead of `lines().next()`.
criteria_check.evidence: plan.rs adds `pub fn title_line`. status.rs adds the status test. store.rs `JobRecords::title` now calls `crate::plan::title_line`.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has a new entry under the unreleased section describing the title fix.
criteria_check.evidence: A new '### Fixed' entry sits under '## [Unreleased]'.

mistakes: My first status test used an invalid job id and a nonexistent OutcomeState variant. I fixed both before reporting.
learnings: Plan and status titles both come from JobRecords::title in store.rs, so one fix there changes both.
Job ids in tests must look like YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-xxxx.
